title: Niva Bupa names Anjali Raghavan as MD and CEO
body: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company has appointed Anjali Raghavan as managing director and chief executive officer with effect from 1 October 2026, subject to approval from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India. She succeeds Vikram Sethi, who steps down on 30 September 2026 and who has held the role since 2020. Raghavan joins from Aditya Birla Health Insurance, where she was chief distribution officer.
